summary.intent: Build and validate a closed-loop autoresearch system that models AI agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) through Cohezion's Quadrature Nexus, capturing journeys in SurrealDB and improving the system via Ouroboros and Mycelium feedback synthesis.
summary.outcome: Delivered E1-E64 experiments proving the Mycelium closed loop works (consensus +0.0625 at lr=1.0, +0.1250 at lr=2.0, threshold crossing confirmed), committed the E57 additive calibration production fix with 11 regression tests, established experimental methodology with retirement criterion, and fixed multiple pre-existing bugs in ARC solver and test suite. 225K+ SurrealDB journey_point records accumulated.

repo: QuadratureNexus uses a two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration (cross-cycle stable accumulator) vs _score_adjustments (per-deliberation, overwritten by run_llm_deliberation on every call at line ~307). Experiments must call nexus.deliberate() directly to preserve Mycelium adjustments.

SurrealDB HTTP endpoint requires 'RETURN true;' as a probe (not 'SELECT 1;' which returns 400). Datetime fields require time::now() not string literals. SCHEMAFULL tables block undeclared metadata subfields — store variable data in option<string> result field as JSON.
Gemini worktrees (.gemini/worktrees/) are ephemeral and get cleaned up — all code edits in a worktree are lost when the session ends. Always commit to the main repo or a permanent branch.

The voice→manifold mapping in ManifoldEnv: Architect→space (dims 0-2), Engineer→field (dims 4,5,8), Ethicist→control (dim 9), Resource→precipitation (dim 11). All experiments need fresh nexus instances to avoid state contamination between experimental conditions.

Lemonade local inference server (port 13307) can enter silent failure mode where it returns empty strings for all evaluation prompts but still responds to arithmetic. Always test with a functional probe ('2+2=') not just the /models endpoint.

pre-commit hook runs ruff format --check unconditionally — must run ruff format on files before staging, or the commit is rejected. The Playwright hook needs a 'files:' filter to avoid running when no UI files are staged.

The ARC beam solver UCB1 exploration policy conflated 'what to expand next' with 'best final answer': untested transforms (trials=0, UCB1=∞) always ranked above confirmed-correct ones. Fixed by tracking best-scoring candidate separately from the exploration beam.
asyncio.wait_for() with a negative timeout raises TimeoutError immediately without sleeping — causes tight spin loops when remaining_s < 0. Must guard with max(30.0, remaining_s - 10).
Mycelium convergence formula: consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n. At lr=1.0 asymptotically approaches 0.85; at lr=2.0 crosses exactly in one cycle. Validated to max_error=0.00025.

code.finding: E57 production fix: apply_mycelium_feedback() changed from SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) to additive (_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]). _mycelium_calibration must be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0). Without this, every Mycelium cycle replaces the previous calibration with a smaller value as the gap shrinks — producing decay not compounding.

_evaluate_resource() was purely boolean (budget_available gives +0.15, else 0). Extended to add +0.10 bonus when description contains cost/budget/efficient/resource/reduce keywords, making it text-sensitive like other voices.

Full rewrite from simulation to real HTTP. connect() must probe with 'RETURN true;'. ensure_journey() UPSERT needs all required SCHEMAFULL fields including transaction_time: time::now(). insert_flume_journey_event() packs EVO biography into result field (option<string>) as JSON because SCHEMAFULL blocks arbitrary metadata subfields.

beam_search UCB1 bug: untested transforms (trials=0) always rank above confirmed-correct ones (UCB1=∞ > any finite value). Fixed by tracking best_candidate by actual score separately from the UCB1-ranked exploration beam.

Test for invert detection used [[0,1],[1,0]]→[[1,0],[0,1]] which is also solvable by flip_h (row reversal). Ambiguous test data — DFS returned flip_h first. Fixed by using test data only solvable by inversion.

New file: 11 regression tests for E57 additive calibration fix. Synthesized skill format must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' pattern (output of _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill), not voice_scores=[...] format (ingest input). test_lr2_crosses_threshold verifies consensus >= 0.85 at lr=2.0.

_check_retirement() added: retires experiment if (a) keep_frac=1.0 with CV<0.05 after 20 keeps (converged attractor) OR (b) keep_frac=0.0 after min_runs (confirmed noise). Label normalization required — SCHEDULE labels like 'E12_persist' must strip suffix to match JSONL 'E12' experiment keys.

New 2-hour driver script using timeit.default_timer() for microsecond wall-clock timing. Spin-loop bug at deadline: asyncio.wait_for with remaining_s<10 passes negative timeout → immediate TimeoutError loop. Fixed with remaining_s<30 guard and max(30.0, computed_timeout).

workflow: Experimental methodology lesson: pre-specifying the keep criterion before running is essential. E50, E54, E60 each needed 2-3 redesigns because initial metrics were either unachievable (dev_ratio<0.80) or measuring the wrong thing (float mean vs result.approved for threshold crossing).

Retirement criterion prevents 'zombie experiments': E51 ran 4,786 times with no stop condition before retirement logic was added. CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 is a clean convergence signal.
IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 in floating point. Use result.approved (direct comparison against class constant) as authoritative threshold crossing signal, not float mean comparisons.

When a PR is 210 commits behind its target, rebase is risky for lint-only branches where main may have applied the same fixes independently. git merge-tree is safer for testing mergeability without touching the working tree.
The overnight loop must be restarted to pick up code changes — Python loads the script at startup. SIGTERM triggers clean stop after current experiment.
Always run ruff format before staging — the pre-commit hook runs ruff format --check and rejects unformatted files, requiring re-stage after formatting.

Vault observations should be written as findings accumulate, not batched. The Gemini worktree loss showed that uncommitted work (E55-E62 experiments) can be lost entirely — vault provides persistence independent of git.
SurrealDB journey_point count is the ground truth for persistence health. 'connected=True' does not mean data is reaching the DB — test by reading back a record you just wrote.

friction: Gemini worktree (.gemini/worktrees/) was silently cleaned up, destroying 3500 lines of new experiment code (E55-E62) that was only in the worktree. Had to reconstruct from session notes.

pre-commit hook blocks every commit with ruff format --check — requires manual format-stage-commit cycle. Playwright hook runs unconditionally even on Python-only changes, failing without a running Next.js server.
An interactive rebase (104 commits) was started by a concurrent process and left in progress, causing detached HEAD state that blocked pushing.

SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables silently reject arbitrary nested metadata fields — inserts succeed (200 OK) but records contain empty metadata. Required moving all variable data to an option<string> result field.
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulated over the session (4+ instances), competing for experiment slots and event queue entries. Required periodic kill-all-restart.

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments on every call, silently wiping Mycelium adjustments before the next deliberation reads them. This was the root cause of 5 failed experiment designs before E55 identified it.

Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure mode where all evaluation prompts return empty strings — no error, just empty response. Arithmetic still works. Required switching to heuristic mode for overnight runs.

The autoresearch spin-loop bug at session deadline (remaining_s < 0 → asyncio.wait_for with negative timeout → immediate TimeoutError → re-check deadline → still negative) generated thousands of spurious monitor notifications before being caught.
open_items: E64 multi-cycle Mycelium compounding experiment was designed and added to the schedule but never ran long enough to accumulate 20 keeps — predicted to cross 0.85 threshold at cycle 4 with lr=1.0.

apply_mycelium_feedback() has no callers in src/ beyond its own definition — the E57 production fix is deployed but dormant. Needs to be called from CompoundExecutor or a production deliberation pipeline to have real-world effect.
SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code to persist experiment results was in the lost Gemini worktree and was never re-implemented in the main repo scripts.

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (treating phase resets as production drift). Should be filtered to only fire on genuine session-level EVOs, not experiment-internal ones.
Mycelium synthesized skills from experiments use local MyceliumRegistry instances that die with the run. Synthesized skills never feed back into the production CompoundExecutor._mycelium_registry.

JEPA learning (E46) is bounded by flat input distribution in heuristic mode — all deliberations produce nearly identical 12D state vectors. Needs LLM mode with genuine voice score variance to produce meaningful training gradient.
PRs 102-111 were closed (not merged) — unclear whether their changes were incorporated into main via other means or were abandoned.

The retirement criterion is in-memory per process — converged experiments (E12, E46, E47) re-run from scratch each overnight session restart. Seeding from autoresearch.jsonl history on startup would avoid redundant warmup runs.
The test suite has 280 pre-existing failures unrelated to EVO research work — needs a triage pass to establish which are genuinely broken vs environment-specific vs intentionally xfail.
